entities.name: Oyobi
entities.description: Enormous kami of Kamigawa resembling a giant eagle with gossamer ribbons and feathers for a body.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Daimyo who sent mothriders against Oyobi.

entities.name: Mothriders
entities.description: Elite flight sent by Konda that was toppled by bird-like kami.

entities.name: Jukai forest
entities.description: Forest above whose border Oyobi manifested.

entities.name: Towabara
entities.description: Border of which Jukai's treeline was part.

events.summary: Oyobi starts manifesting above the border of Jukai forest three months before the massacre at Reito; Konda sends mothriders to deal with her.
events.quote: Konda sent a flight of his elite mothriders to deal with her

events.summary: Oyobi manifests fully and countless bird-like kami topple every rider into the Jukai forest.
events.quote: every rider had been toppled from his moth, plummeting into the Jukai forest below
